question: Which of the following states has the highest poverty rate in India, according to the Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2021**, **Bihar** has the** highest poverty rate **in India.
 
• The MPI is a measure of **acute poverty **that captures the various deprivations experienced by individuals at the **same time**.
 
• Bihar has consistently ranked among the poorest states in India, with a** high percentage **of people living below the** poverty line.**
 
• The state has also been affected by various **socio-economic challenges** such as **low literacy rates, lack of access to basic amenities, and limited job opportunities.**
 
• **Madhya Pradesh, Jharkhand, and Uttar Pradesh **are also among the poorest states in India, but they have a relatively lower poverty rate compared to Bihar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India's MPI value decreased by almost half between 2015–16 and 2019–21, from **0.117 to 0.066.**
 
• **Madhya Pradesh**:
 
 
• The state has made significant progress in reducing poverty in recent years, but still faces challenges related to **malnutrition, low literacy rates,** and** inadequate infrastructure**.
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand:**
 
 
• The state has a high poverty rate and faces challenges related to** low literacy rates, lack of basic amenities, and limited job opportunities.**
 
• However, it has made progress in** reducing poverty** through various government initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh:**
 
 
• The state has a large population and a **high poverty rate**, with a significant proportion of people living in rural areas.
 
• It faces challenges related to **low literacy rates, inadequate infrastructure**, and limited **job opportunities.**
 
• However, the state government has launched **several poverty alleviation programs** to address these issues.
